controlEnvironment: CREATOR_RDG_PARALLEL_SETUP=0 disables declaration branches; 1 enables them.
wiring: LivePipelineDesc::AddNode builds slot and explicit CPU dependencies before DeclareAll.
nodeStorage: CreateDeclarationBranch assigns private resource/version/pass storage and retained arenas; ready nodes execute their declarations on jobs.
inputs: SnapshotDeclarationResource lazily copies published resource metadata. FindImportedBuffer/Texture consult parent imports. CanonicalDeclarationHandle maps identities into the active declaration space.
publication: The owner joins and merges declarations in original node order; compiled pass usages reference canonical root handles.
lifetimes: The root retains declaration branches and callbacks; graph reset retains capacities and occurs behind the existing queue-idle/RHI/GPU retirement checks. Accepted tasks drain before snapshots or context storage are released.
reuse: Branch graph pool, declaration arenas, setup task vector capacities, and per-thread meshlet declaration/upload scratch are reused.
identityFixes: Resource comparisons and read normalization include branch identity, kind and epoch; resident buffers, effects, decals, sprites and UI no longer conflate local indices.
regressions: RDG_BRANCH_IMPORT_LOOKUP_OK parent lookup cross-branch normalization reset
